ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High white-to-black ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels to 15% low-intensity black/dark grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field extending to lobes. Continuous black border on leading edges. Irregular black pigmentation along the trailing edge. Dispersed circular dark spots (scars) primarily in the lower-central region and mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an internal pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees; depth is approximately 12% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge with vertical amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature from the median notch extending towards the mid-lobe, transitioning to convex curvature as it reaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-like high-contrast marks (dark perimeters with light centers) clustered in the lower central fluke area and mid-right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions observed on the right lobe near the interior trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization on the distal tips and scattered along the trailing edge. Significant irregular chipping and notch patterns on the trailing edge boundary likely resulting from physical interactions.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced barnacle encrustation on the extreme lateral edges, significantly altering the smooth geometric profile of the fluke tips.
